result.question: Qual a evolução anual da taxa de mortalidade por estado (MA e RS)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu."SG_UF", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mu."SG_UF", ano ORDER BY mu."SG_UF", ano;
